attributes.name: Mythic Guardian
attributes.powers:
Add your number of mythic charges to your Strength or Constitution check. Then you may expend 1 or more charges. If you do, when you assemble your dice, for each charge expended, replace 1 of your highest non-d20 dice with a d20 and you may reroll and dice that rolled a 1; take the new result.

When a character is attempting to close your location, you may expend 5 mythic charges; that character does not need to fulfill the When Closing requirement and automatically closes the location.
